name: wayfinder
description: A pane beside the chat showing this session's plan, git state and timeline, plus your other recent sessions.

autoStart.title: Turn on in new sessions
autoStart.description: Off: Wayfinder stays off in each session until you type /wayfinder.

othersDays.title: Other sessions: days back
othersDays.description: Other sessions show while they moved within this many days.

maxOthers.title: Other sessions: how many
maxOthers.description: The most other sessions the pane lists.

commitDates.title: Show commit ages
commitDates.description: Off: the timeline shows no "4d ago" beside commits.

maxCommits.title: Commits in a repo's graph: at most
maxCommits.description: The newest ones stay; older ones are counted as not shown.
